headline: Teach Claude a task once, as a folder
subline: Skills are folders of instructions, scripts and resources that Claude loads dynamically for specialized tasks.
why: Each skill is self-contained: one folder with a SKILL.md (name + description frontmatter)
Includes the docx, pdf, pptx and xlsx skills behind Claude's document features
Works in Claude Code (plugin marketplace), Claude.ai paid plans and the Claude API
